SELECT account_code, account_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS amt_aug,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS amt_sep
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance
WHERE account_type='opex' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY account_code, account_name
ORDER BY ABS(amt_sep - amt_aug) DESC
